originalSentence: I started learning English two years ago.
answer: I have learned English for two years.
explanation: Dùng hiện tại hoàn thành với for + khoảng thời gian.

originalSentence: She started working here in 2022.
answer: She has worked here since 2022.
explanation: Dùng hiện tại hoàn thành với since + mốc thời gian.

originalSentence: I last saw Mary three months ago.
answer: I haven't seen Mary for three months.
explanation: Chuyển 'last saw ... ago' sang hiện tại hoàn thành phủ định với for.

originalSentence: He began studying French in 2020.
answer: He has studied French since 2020.
explanation: Since đi với mốc thời gian 2020.

originalSentence: This is my first visit to Da Nang.
answer: I have never visited Da Nang before.
explanation: First visit có thể đổi sang cấu trúc have never + V3 + before.

originalSentence: I have never eaten sushi before.
answer: This is the first time I have eaten sushi.
explanation: Never ... before ↔ This is the first time + hiện tại hoàn thành.

originalSentence: Tom is taller than John.
answer: John is shorter than Tom.
explanation: Đảo đối tượng và dùng tính từ trái nghĩa để giữ nguyên nghĩa.

originalSentence: This book is more interesting than that one.
answer: That book is less interesting than this one.
explanation: More interesting than ↔ less interesting than khi đổi vị trí hai đối tượng.

originalSentence: My mother cooks better than I do.
answer: I can't cook as well as my mother does.
explanation: So sánh hơn better than ↔ not as well as.

originalSentence: No student in the class is taller than Nam.
answer: Nam is the tallest student in the class.
explanation: Chuyển so sánh hơn mang nghĩa tuyệt đối sang so sánh nhất.

originalSentence: The box is too heavy for me to carry.
answer: The box isn't light enough for me to carry.
explanation: Too + adjective ↔ not + adjective trái nghĩa + enough.

originalSentence: She is too young to drive a car.
answer: She isn't old enough to drive a car.
explanation: Too young to ↔ not old enough to.

originalSentence: The coffee is too hot for me to drink.
answer: The coffee isn't cool enough for me to drink.
explanation: Too hot ↔ not cool enough.

originalSentence: Although he was tired, he continued working.
answer: In spite of being tired, he continued working.
explanation: Although + clause ↔ In spite of + noun/V-ing.

originalSentence: Although it was raining, they went out.
answer: Despite the rain, they went out.
explanation: Although + clause có thể đổi sang Despite + noun phrase.

originalSentence: Because it rained heavily, we stayed at home.
answer: Because of the heavy rain, we stayed at home.
explanation: Because + clause ↔ Because of + noun phrase.

originalSentence: Because he was ill, he didn't go to school.
answer: Because of his illness, he didn't go to school.
explanation: Đổi mệnh đề he was ill thành cụm danh từ his illness.

originalSentence: They are building a new school near my house.
answer: A new school is being built near my house.
explanation: Bị động hiện tại tiếp diễn: am/is/are being + V3.

originalSentence: They built this bridge in 2010.
answer: This bridge was built in 2010.
explanation: Bị động quá khứ đơn: was/were + V3.

originalSentence: People speak English in many countries.
answer: English is spoken in many countries.
explanation: Bị động hiện tại đơn: am/is/are + V3.

originalSentence: They will finish the project next week.
answer: The project will be finished next week.
explanation: Bị động tương lai đơn: will be + V3.

originalSentence: Someone has stolen my bike.
answer: My bike has been stolen.
explanation: Bị động hiện tại hoàn thành: has/have been + V3.

originalSentence: You should study harder or you will fail the exam.
answer: If you don't study harder, you will fail the exam.
explanation: Or mang nghĩa cảnh báo có thể đổi sang câu điều kiện loại 1.

originalSentence: Hurry up or you will miss the bus.
answer: If you don't hurry up, you will miss the bus.
explanation: Mệnh lệnh + or ↔ If + phủ định, will + V.

originalSentence: Study hard and you will pass the exam.
answer: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
explanation: Mệnh lệnh + and ↔ If + hiện tại đơn, will + V.

originalSentence: I don't have enough money, so I can't buy the laptop.
answer: If I had enough money, I could buy the laptop.
explanation: Tình huống không có thật ở hiện tại dùng câu điều kiện loại 2.

originalSentence: He doesn't study, so he gets bad marks.
answer: If he studied, he wouldn't get bad marks.
explanation: Đưa nguyên nhân hiện tại không có thật sang câu điều kiện loại 2.

originalSentence: I used to play football every afternoon.
answer: I don't play football every afternoon anymore.
explanation: Used to diễn tả thói quen trong quá khứ không còn ở hiện tại.

originalSentence: She no longer lives in this city.
answer: She used to live in this city.
explanation: No longer ở hiện tại có thể đổi sang used to ở quá khứ.

originalSentence: When I was a child, I often visited my grandparents.
answer: I used to visit my grandparents when I was a child.
explanation: Thói quen quá khứ thường xuyên có thể dùng used to.

originalSentence: He is a careful driver.
answer: He drives carefully.
explanation: Chuyển adjective + noun sang verb + adverb.

originalSentence: She is a beautiful singer.
answer: She sings beautifully.
explanation: Beautiful là tính từ; bổ nghĩa cho động từ sing dùng beautifully.

originalSentence: He speaks English fluently.
answer: He is a fluent English speaker.
explanation: Chuyển adverb fluently sang adjective fluent.

originalSentence: The test was so difficult that I couldn't finish it.
answer: The test was too difficult for me to finish.
explanation: So + adjective + that ↔ too + adjective + for + object + to V.

originalSentence: The room was so small that we couldn't stay there.
answer: The room was too small for us to stay in.
explanation: So...that có thể đổi sang too...to khi giữ nguyên nghĩa.

originalSentence: The water is so cold that I can't swim in it.
answer: The water is too cold for me to swim in.
explanation: So cold that I can't ↔ too cold for me to.

originalSentence: The last time I visited Hue was two years ago.
answer: I haven't visited Hue for two years.
explanation: The last time ... ago ↔ haven't + V3 + for.

originalSentence: It is three years since I last met him.
answer: I haven't met him for three years.
explanation: It is + time + since + past ↔ haven't + V3 + for + time.

originalSentence: He started living here five years ago.
answer: He has lived here for five years.
explanation: Started ... ago ↔ has/have + V3 + for.

originalSentence: The film was very boring. We left early.
answer: Because the film was very boring, we left early.
explanation: Kết hợp nguyên nhân-kết quả bằng Because + clause.

originalSentence: The weather was bad. We still went camping.
answer: Although the weather was bad, we still went camping.
explanation: Kết hợp hai ý tương phản bằng Although.

originalSentence: The man is my teacher. He is standing over there.
answer: The man who is standing over there is my teacher.
explanation: Dùng đại từ quan hệ who cho người làm chủ ngữ.

originalSentence: I bought a book. It was very interesting.
answer: The book which I bought was very interesting.
explanation: Dùng which cho vật trong mệnh đề quan hệ.

originalSentence: This is the girl. Her father is a doctor.
answer: This is the girl whose father is a doctor.
explanation: Whose dùng để chỉ sở hữu trong mệnh đề quan hệ.

originalSentence: Let's go to the cinema tonight.
answer: Why don't we go to the cinema tonight?
explanation: Let's + V ↔ Why don't we + V?

originalSentence: How about going for a walk?
answer: Let's go for a walk.
explanation: How about + V-ing ↔ Let's + V.

originalSentence: You should see a doctor.
answer: If I were you, I would see a doctor.
explanation: Lời khuyên có thể đổi sang If I were you, I would...

originalSentence: It isn't necessary for you to come early.
answer: You don't have to come early.
explanation: It isn't necessary ↔ don't have to.

originalSentence: It is necessary for students to wear uniforms.
answer: Students have to wear uniforms.
explanation: It is necessary for... ↔ have to.

originalSentence: Perhaps Tom will come to the party.
answer: Tom may come to the party.
explanation: Perhaps + future possibility ↔ may + V.
